data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that shows a command palette similar to VS Code or Slack.
data.what_it_does: It lets users trigger actions via a keyboard shortcut or programmatically. The palette supports nested actions, custom filtering, and optional keyboardless access.
use_when: You need a quick, global command interface in a Flutter app
You want to expose many actions without cluttering the UI
You need keyboard shortcuts on desktop or web
avoid_when: You only need a single action or simple button
You are building a non‑Flutter platform
You require heavy custom styling beyond the provided builder
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget
Supports nested actions and custom filtering
Keyboard shortcut support out of the box
weaknesses: Limited styling customization without writing a custom builder
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and place CommandPalette widget in the tree
